# The Balanced Plate

> > A culinary arts blog documenting a nutritionist's journey through culinary and pastry school, featuring healthy recipes, cooking techniques, and nutrition insights.

Written by Laura, a nutritionist based in New York City, this blog chronicles her experiences at culinary school while maintaining a focus on nutrition, fresh ingredients, and balanced eating. The site features recipes, restaurant reviews, and reflections on classic cooking techniques from Italian, French, and Asian cuisines.

## Key Topics

- culinary school
- nutrition facts
- home cooking
- Italian cuisine
- pastry baking
- cooking techniques
- fresh ingredients
- whole wheat flour
- comfort food
- spices
- practical exams
- healthy recipes
- New York City
- baking recipes
- salsas

## Recipe Collection

- [Banana Bread with Whole Wheat Flour](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/recipes/banana-bread-with-whole-wheat-flour): Healthy whole wheat banana bread recipe with applesauce and honey
- [Scalloped Potatoes](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/recipes/scalloped-potatoes): Scalloped potatoes with smoked gouda, sage, and russet potatoes recipe
- [Salsas](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/recipes/salsas): Salsa recipes: pico de gallo, mango salsa, and guacamole collection

## Culinary School Journey

- [Final Challenge Results](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/07/26/final-challenge-results): Culinary school final challenge: pan-fried veal breast with 2-hour time limit
- [Iron Chef Challenge #2](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/07/17/iron-chef-challenge-2): Culinary school Iron Chef: striped bass, stone fruit, poussin challenge
- [Scalloped Potatoes](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/05/03/scalloped-potatoes): Culinary school practical exam prep: potato preparation techniques
- [Tarts](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/05/13/tarts): Pastry school: pie shells, pastry cream, frangipane, and fruit tarts
- [Curry](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/04/22/curry): Asian cooking in culinary school: Indian curry techniques and spices
- [Pasta!](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/04/07/pasta): Italian cooking class: fresh pasta, lasagna, ravioli, and gnocchi making

## Cooking Techniques & Ingredients

- [Tomatoes](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/08/29/tomatoes): Heirloom tomato varieties: Mr. Stripey, Persimmon, Cherokee Purple guide
- [Salsas and Grilled Fish](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/04/23/salsas-and-grilled-fish): Healthy grilled fish with fresh salsas and plantains recipe
- [Ragu Bolognese](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/04/15/ragu-bolognese): Traditional Italian ragu Bolognese: meaty sauce from Bologna technique
- [Sauerkraut and Bratwurst](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/03/27/sauerkraut-and-bratwurst): Choucroute Garni: Alsace-Lorraine sauerkraut and sausage with nutrition
- [Bagels](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/05/22/bagels): NYC bagels: water theory, baking techniques, and nutrition facts

## Nutrition & Healthy Eating

- [Spice Up Your Diet](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/04/30/spice-up-your-diet): Nutrition tips: adding healthy spices to home cooking and diet
- [Farm Fresh Eggs](https://thebalancedplate.wordpress.com/2008/03/22/farm-fresh-eggs): Union Square farmers market eggs: nutrition, omega-3s, and cholesterol
